nodes.title: 共享负面提示词 (FLUX 留空)
任务/地图批量出图说明 - 拆分批 b (共10张)
widgets_values:
■ 工作流: 任务标识 + 地图图例批量生成 (FLUX) - 拆分批 b
   一次 Queue Prompt 出全部 10 张
   预计耗时 55-65 分钟 (M4 Pro)

■ 序列组成:
   1-4 任务标识 (菱形 QUEST_DIAMOND)
        main/side/encounter/complete
   5-10 地图标记 (圆形 MAP_CIRCLE)
         current/town/sect/dungeon/enemy/merchant

■ 风格一致性:
   - 共享 seed 88888888 (fixed)
   - 共享 EmptyLatent 1024x1024
   - 菱形/圆形两种外框, 与 11a 扁平方形盲识区分

■ 输出 (每张 2 份, 与 11a 同目录):
   output/wuxia_system_1024/quest_*|map_*.png  (1024 母版)
   output/wuxia_system_96/quest_*|map_*.png    (96 游戏图标)

■ 命名规范 (前缀区分子类):
   quest_icon_*.png  → 任务标识
   map_icon_*.png    → 地图标记
   均由 import_ai_assets.sh 自动回流到
   assets/ui/system_icons/

■ 单张重抽: 同前

■ 注意:
   - 菱形/圆形外框是 FLUX 的弱项, 生成后逐张目检
   - 若整批菱形崩坏, 把 PROMPT_TEMPLATE_QUEST_DIAMOND 中
     rhombus 改为 octagon 或 square 重抽

nodes.title: 1. quest_icon_main - 正面
widgets_values: A minimalist game UI quest marker icon for a cultivation wuxia RPG, centered composition. Subject: a single golden exclamation mark stylized as a daoist rune symbol in the center, with a pulsing golden halo around it. The subject occupies about 65 percent of the canvas in the center, framed inside a single closed rhombus diamond shape standing on its point, the diamond drawn as a uniform thin gold line, perfectly symmetric along both the vertical and horizontal axes, no decoration on the diamond frame itself. Pure clean solid white background, no other elements. Flat vector illustration style, simplified for icon use. brilliant gold and warm radiant gold halo color palette only. No realistic human portraits, no facial features, no complex patterns, no maze patterns, no text, no chinese characters, no multiple subjects, no debris, no asymmetric elements outside the diamond. Single focal point on the central subject. Designed to be readable when scaled down to 48x48 pixels. Symmetric and balanced composition. Highest quality concept art for game UI.
